headline: Short-period SSE slop, glassy early then onshore — log it before lunch or skip it.
today: Marginal-angle SSE windswell at 3-5s, so it's soft and disorganized but there's waist-ish stuff to poke at. Dawn N offshore and light SSW through morning keep it clean; the SSE fills in onshore by afternoon and it goes to junk. Get your log wet around the morning low pushing toward the incoming, then bail.

daysToWatch.note: Small at 1.6ft but a SE good-angle line sneaks in at up to 9.9s, and afternoon goes offshore NNW with light evening. Cleanest water of the week even if it's tiny — glassy log session.
Bumps up to 3.6ft but it's marginal S angle at short period and afternoon S wind hits 15mph onshore. Bigger on paper, blown-out and junky in reality.
